title: Implement and harden the accepted HarnessTask contract
objective: Historical Stage-2A implementation record superseded by the bounded minimum durable HarnessTask simplification; its 21-interface architecture was not human-accepted.
authorized_scope: Implement exactly the accepted 16-field schema-version-2 HarnessTask and the original accepted 19 project-local public interfaces without changing their fields, signatures, ownership boundaries, or wire behavior; add only the explicitly authorized narrow runtime-only HarnessTaskMigrationReviewDocument and HarnessTaskMigrationReviewPacketRenderer correction, for a corrected total of 21 interfaces.

Add the accepted project-local schema, projection profile, fixtures, serializer and deserializer, LocalValidationResult graph validation, documentation rendering, byte-structural comparator, packet preparation, deterministic complete human-review packet rendering, migration-disposition behavior, public imports, and explicit resource-manifest relationships.

Complete the explicitly deferred Stage-2 hardening decisions for PIHL.TASK codes and precedence, authoritative-template parsing, comparator algorithms, schema fixtures, accepted ResourcePath rejection cases, and focused tests without reopening the accepted public contract.
Preserve mixed Markdown and JSON TaskRecordAdapter compatibility and exact TaskStateInspector behavior for the existing version-1 JSON pilot and all six unchanged Markdown Tasks.

Use a representative non-migration example with a manually supplied HarnessTask to demonstrate canonical JSON serialization, rendered Markdown behavior, opaque source preservation, and exact source/rendered differences; label it as illustrative or synthetic test evidence rather than a Markdown-to-JSON extraction or real migration packet.
Produce maintained public documentation and focused class-owned and genuine artifact-owned software-verification evidence under the accepted project procedures.
Complete one independent review, explicitly disposition every material finding, deterministically verify every correction, and retain the original review result without a repeated-review loop.
At completion, prepare one concise implementation-acceptance packet that is understandable without reading mappings, command transcripts, or every test and then stop for explicit human acceptance.
completion_criteria: Implemented production code, corrected 21-interface public imports, schemas, fixtures, profiles, manifests, adapters, inspection behavior, focused tests, and maintained documentation agree with the accepted Stage-1 contract plus the explicitly authorized runtime-only human-review rendering correction, or any other difference is identified as a blocker requiring human contract review.

Exact PIHL.TASK diagnostics and precedence, template parsing, comparator algorithms, schema fixtures, ResourcePath rejection behavior, and hardening tests are documented and verified without silently changing the accepted contract.

The representative example explicitly identifies its manually supplied HarnessTask, retained source identity, canonical HarnessTask JSON, rendered Markdown, and exact source/rendered diff, but demonstrates no Markdown-to-JSON extraction, is not a real file-migration packet, and changes none of the six authoritative Markdown Tasks.
The independent review and one correction pass, if needed, satisfy the accepted review semantics and leave no material finding unresolved.

The concise human packet lists: exact production files added or changed; final public API table; every difference from the accepted Stage-1 contract; one representative manually supplied HarnessTask canonical-JSON serialization, rendered-Markdown, and source-comparison example; exact source/rendered diff; focused test and validation results; independent-review findings and dispositions; known limitations; confirmation that all six Markdown Tasks remain authoritative and unchanged; and the proposed Stage-2B activation boundary.
A human implementation-acceptance checkpoint is pending, and no Stage-2B activation, real migration packet, or source migration has occurred.
exclusions: Do not prepare a real migration packet, create candidate JSON or maintained documentation for any of the six source Tasks, or migrate, replace, rename, delete, or modify any selected Markdown Task.

Do not silently change the accepted Stage-1 fields, signatures, ownership boundaries, wire contract, documentation destinations, mapping semantics, or review behavior; route any material required change to explicit human contract review.

Do not activate Stage 2B, infer implementation acceptance from tests or review, synchronize the accepted version-1 legacy projection drift unless separately authorized, implement selection state, cut over or delete the chain, or activate a successor.
Do not add dependencies, change lockfiles, or perform SQLite, telemetry, scientific, publication, external, protected, release, or unrelated harness work.
